description: Read the running service status, pinned version, registry counts, built brands, themes, token scopes and retained proof summaries. Uptime and latency are current process measurements; host paths are omitted. includeChangelog adds the DSL changelog, and sinceVersion keeps entries after that version. catalog_list and object_registry read the definitions behind the counts.

includeChangelog.description: When true, include DSL version changelog in the response.

reproduce.description: Include the command and calls for reproducing this result.

sinceVersion.description: When provided with includeChangelog, only return changelog entries since this version.

name: health_check
title: Check Health
